name: Spectro Cloud
summary:
Spectro Cloud provides Kubernetes management and infrastructure orchestration technologies for cloud, edge, AI, and enterprise platform environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Spectro Cloud environments across cloud, hybrid, edge, and bare metal infrastructure platforms. From Kubernetes lifecycle management and fleet orchestration through to AI infrastructure and operational governance, we help teams create scalable, resilient, and operationally consistent cloud-native environments.
overview:
Spectro Cloud helps organisations manage Kubernetes and modern infrastructure environments at scale across cloud, datacentre, edge, and bare metal environments through its Palette platform. The platform focuses on full-stack Kubernetes lifecycle management, infrastructure orchestration, fleet management, and AI infrastructure operations.  

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Spectro Cloud environments across enterprise Kubernetes infrastructure. From Kubernetes lifecycle management and edge deployments through to AI infrastructure orchestration and operational governance, we help teams create environments that are secure, scalable, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building modern Kubernetes platform foundations that support long-term operational scalability and resilience. This includes lifecycle automation, observability, cluster governance, infrastructure orchestration, platform security, and operational enablement across complex cloud-native environments.

We help organisations reduce operational complexity, improve platform resilience, and operate Kubernetes environments with confidence.
